tools_problematic.problem: The bootstrap and its dependent Test-Path self-check ran concurrently, so the check returned False before bootstrap completed.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt turn 2 lines 320-358; the same check returned True in turn 3.

tools_problematic.problem: Reading the shared Styles.xaml without a range exceeded the file-size limit.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt turn 5 lines 1148-1172; the agent recovered by reading ranges in turn 7.

tool_limitations.limitation: It recursively copied only the supplied project directory and ignored external MSBuild Include items with Link metadata, omitting the shared shell XAML/code, scenario XAML, styles, and assets.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Parse UWP project Include/Link metadata and materialize resolvable linked source files at their logical target paths before triage.

tool_limitations.limitation: It warned that MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md had content when the bootstrap-generated table contained only the '(none)' placeholder.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Treat the generated '(none)' row as an empty deferred set.

failed_apis.why_tried: The UWP NetworkStatusChanged callback marshalled work to the UI thread with the UWP dispatcher.
failed_apis.fix: Use the Page DispatcherQueue and TryEnqueue the UI update.

doc_errors.wrong: The text implied namespace rewrites were sufficient for compiled binding types and separately treated WMC9999 as a dangling resource-key signal.
doc_errors.correct: When WMC0909 precedes WMC1111/WMC9999, unresolved x:DataType is the root cause; verify type visibility/namespace/build inclusion or use ordinary Binding for simple display templates.

special_apis.special_handling: The callback is not guaranteed to run on the UI thread; marshal UI changes through DispatcherQueue and unsubscribe when navigating away.
SDK-style implicit usings can make HttpClient ambiguous with System.Net.Http.HttpClient, and these result APIs require Windows 10 version 18362 or later.

errors_encountered.error: CS0104: HttpClient is ambiguous between System.Net.Http.HttpClient and Windows.Web.Http.HttpClient.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The SDK-style target's implicit System.Net.Http import collided with the retained Windows.Web.Http import.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909, WMC1111, and WMC9999 in MainPage.xaml DataTemplate.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The XAML compiler could not resolve local:Scenario for x:DataType; the later missing-data-type and internal errors were cascading diagnostics.
errors_encountered.fix: For this simple title template, remove x:DataType and replace x:Bind with Binding.

errors_encountered.error: CS8602 nullable dereference warnings for connection profiles.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The source dereferenced a nullable ConnectionProfile after a connectivity-level check that did not prove non-null to the compiler.
errors_encountered.fix: Include profile != null in the branch condition before GetConnectionCost.

errors_encountered.error: CA1416 warnings for HttpGetStringResult APIs introduced in Windows 10 version 18362.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The scaffold minimum was 17763 while the source UWP project minimum was 22621.
errors_encountered.fix: Carry forward an adequate TargetPlatformMinVersion; use annotations/guards only when older-OS support is intentional.

errors_encountered.error: Validate-UwpMigration warning: MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The validator counted the bootstrap's '(none)' placeholder as content.
errors_encountered.fix: Exclude the placeholder from deferred data rows.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent manually located, read in chunks, recreated, and wired shared shell XAML/code/styles/assets that were absent from the bootstrap map.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Approximately 14 turns before the first build.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The bootstrap ignored linked project items outside the supplied source directory.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent inspected the UWP csproj and sibling SharedContent tree, then manually copied/reconstructed the linked items.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Teach Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to copy Include items with Link metadata.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The mandatory mapping self-check first returned False and had to be repeated.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The dependent check was launched in parallel with the bootstrap.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent reran Test-Path after bootstrap completed.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Follow the existing sequential Step 0 command order.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The first build failed with one ambiguous type and a three-error XAML diagnostic chain.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: SDK implicit-using collision and unresolved DataTemplate x:DataType were not covered by the migration diagnostics.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent qualified HttpClient and changed the simple compiled binding to Binding.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Add targeted CS0104 and WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999 guidance.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Six CA1416 warnings led to three edits: an unused using, an attribute, then the effective minimum-OS project fix.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Project reconciliation guidance did not say to preserve a higher UWP TargetPlatformMinVersion.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The target minimum was raised to 18362.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Document source/target minimum-OS reconciliation and when annotations are inappropriate.

missing_tooling.would_have_saved: Manual discovery and reconstruction of the shared shell, three scenario XAML files, styles, and assets across turns 5-18.
